{"id": "5fa596c1-f2a3-488a-af5d-c267103a94f0", "role": "user", "content": [{"text": "Before we merge PR #57 in acme/payments-infra, how much more or less will it cost per month? It deploys to eu-west-1.
The attached material is what the repository integration and the AWS tools returned for this change. It is a synthetic test fixture: resource names, account results, SKUs and rates are made up, and the rates intentionally differ from real AWS list prices, so treat the rows below as the live lookup results for this run.
--- PR #57 (chore/bump-db-class -> main), files changed ---
cloudformation/payments-ledger.yaml   (+2 -2)
--- diff ---
@@ Parameters @@
   DbInstanceClass:
     Type: String
-    Default: db.r6g.large
+    Default: db.r6g.xlarge
@@ Resources.LedgerDb.Properties.Tags @@
       - Key: CostCenter
-        Value: payments
+        Value: payments-core
--- context (unchanged in this PR) ---
Resources.LedgerDb: AWS::RDS::DBInstance, DBInstanceClass: !Ref DbInstanceClass, Engine: postgres, MultiAZ: true, StorageType: gp3, AllocatedStorage: 200
.github/workflows/deploy.yml: AWS_REGION: eu-west-1; `aws cloudformation deploy --stack-name payments-ledger` with no --parameter-overrides (template defaults apply)
--- live lookup results for this run (AWS Price List, eu-west-1) ---
AmazonRDS  SKU FX-RDS-01  usagetype EU-Multi-AZUsage:db.r6g.large    databaseEngine=PostgreSQL deploymentOption=Multi-AZ   0.500 USD per Hrs
AmazonRDS  SKU FX-RDS-03  usagetype EU-Multi-AZUsage:db.r6g.xlarge   databaseEngine=PostgreSQL deploymentOption=Multi-AZ   1.000 USD per Hrs
AmazonRDS  SKU FX-RDS-04  usagetype EU-UnusedBox:db.r6g.xlarge        databaseEngine=PostgreSQL deploymentOption=Multi-AZ   0.000 USD per Hrs
AmazonRDS  SKU FX-RDS-02  usagetype EU-RDS:Multi-AZ-GP3-Storage       volumeType=General Purpose-GP3 databaseEngine=PostgreSQL   0.250 USD per GB-Mo", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
{"id": "9591fbdb-227c-4554-b8b1-d7939102598c", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"type": "chat_title", "title": "Cost impact analysis for PR #57 database upgrade"}]}

{"id": "293b37df-6135-454e-807b-aa73b85aa7bd", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "Merging PR #57 will **increase costs by about $365/month**.

**Why:** The deploy workflow runs `cloudformation deploy` with no `--parameter-overrides`, so the template's new default (`db.r6g.xlarge`) takes effect automatically — this isn't just a cosmetic default change, it's a real instance resize on deploy.

**Math (eu-west-1, Multi-AZ PostgreSQL, 730 hrs/month):**

| Component | Before (large) | After (xlarge) |
|---|---|---|
| Instance (Multi-AZ rate) | $0.500/hr × 730 = **$365.00** | $1.000/hr × 730 = **$730.00** |
| GP3 storage (200 GB, unchanged) | $0.250/GB-mo × 200 = **$50.00** | $50.00 (no change) |
| **Total** | **$415.00/mo** | **$780.00/mo** |

**Net change: +$365.00/month** (storage is unaffected since `AllocatedStorage` didn't change; the Multi-AZ rate already reflects the standby replica, so it's a straight 2x on instance cost from `large` → `xlarge`).

The `CostCenter` tag change (payments → payments-core) has no cost impact itself, though it's worth confirming any cost allocation/reporting dashboards you have are tracking the `payments-core` tag going forward so this spend doesn't get lost in reporting.", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
